description: Recent calls on the user's account, newest first, with status, answers and outcome (no transcripts). Use to find a call_id, or for "what did they quote last time?". For one call's live status or transcript, use get_call; for a call_around batch, get_batch. Returns nothing until the account has placed a call.

account_key.description: Only for clients without OAuth: the cfm_ API key (from the account page or an earlier setup). Leave out when connected with OAuth.

name: list_calls
title: List recent calls
